mentions.name: Historic
mentions.description: Historic is a private AI video journal: users record short morning, evening, or ad hoc video sessions, which are transcribed and indexed into a searchable archive of their thinking. It uses Apple Fitness–style rings to encourage consistency, and provides monthly insight reports and suggested "build in public" posts.
mentions.problem: Notes apps weren't capturing the author's thinking in full fidelity.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building Historic, a private AI video journal for founders.

You record short morning, evening, or ad hoc sessions, and it transcribes and indexes them into a searchable archive of your thinking.
